context: At the hospital. She asks the driver to help name the baby.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_night_worker
lines.text: A girl. She came out yelling. Like this city. Pick a name. You earned it.

choices.text: Something with a street in it.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_night_worker
lines.text: Grace. God knows we'll need it.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_night_worker
lines.text: Madison. Like the square. Fancy. Okay.

lines.speaker: char.dr_osei
lines.text: Congratulations to whoever you are. Out of my hallway, please.
